scenario.description: ResultSetQueryTypeAggregateGrouped grouped aggregation family replaying all nine registered executions in inventory ordinal order. criteria-by-dot-method groups SupportBean#length_batch(2) by sb.getTheString(); the second E1 send (10,100L then 20,200L) flushes the batch window into one new-only callback [{c0:100,c1:30},{c0:200,c1:30}]. iterate-unbound declares observation iterator: @IterableUnbound keeps select theString as c0, sum(intPrimitive) as c1 from SupportBean group by theString iterable without a view while the pinned listener stays attached unrecorded, and any-order snapshots read [{E1,10}], [{E1,10},{E2,20}], [{E1,21},{E2,20}] after E1/10, E2/20, E1/11. unaggregated-having filters group by theString through having intPrimitive > 5 so E1/3 and E2/5 stay silent before E1/6 and E3/7 each emit one row. wildcard-min projects select *, min(intPrimitive) as minval from SupportBean#length(2) group by theString over G1/10, G1/9, G1/11 rendering the flattened wildcard surface plus minval. aggregation-over-grouped-props replays ESPER-185 irstream volume,symbol,price,count(price) from SupportMarketDataBean#length(5) group by symbol, price with a fifo snapshot after every DELL/IBM send; rows follow window insertion order of group members while count carries the shared group aggregate, and the length-5 evictions surface old rows {1000,DELL,10.0,1} then {900,DELL,11.0,0}. sum-one-view and sum-join share tryAssertionSum on irstream symbol, volume, sum(price) as mySum from SupportMarketDataBean#length(3) where symbol='DELL' or symbol='IBM' or symbol='GE' group by symbol; the join variant seeds SupportBeanString DELL/IBM first (no output) and both take an initial empty any-order snapshot plus one after each subsequent send, with cross-group old rows such as new {IBM,10000,90.0}/old {DELL,10000,52.0}. insert-into deploys s0 avg(price)/sum(volume) over #length(3000), sends IBM/10/20000, then a mid-case deploy step compiles s1 insert into StockAverages together with s2 select * from StockAverages as one module; s0 records {IBM,15.0,60000}, s2 records {IBM,20.0,40000}, s1 keeps its pinned listener attached but unrecorded. multikey-w-array sums value group by array over int[] content-equal keys E1..E7 delivering one new row per send.
